integrity: Proof in RESULT.md; exact and numerical reproducibility checker in verify_chiral_trimer.py; no independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Single homogeneous coherently hopping three-site magnetic ring; instantaneous complete Poisson reset to one pure site state. The result concerns population imbalance rather than a current or first-detection time; no disordered, dephased, interacting, or imperfect-reset extension is proved. The general spectral-resolvent method itself is prior work.
title: Sharp flux–reset optimization and a singular weak-flux population imbalance in a quantum triangle
